Laya conditions

Source: R/conditions.R
laya_conditions.Rd

Every error layaR raises has class laya_error plus a specific class laya_error_<kind>, so you can handle one kind of failure on its own, for example tryCatch(..., laya_error_no_markers = function(e) ...). The kind is also stored in the condition's kind field. Warnings from the engine (for example a long-document window being capped) have class laya_warning.

Details

Kinds from the engine: io, json, artifacts_not_found, directory_not_found, missing_file, download, tokenizer, onnx, invalid_question, invalid_config, checkpoint_mismatch, no_markers, invalid_state, unsupported_aggregate, invalid_window, not_supported, invalid_min_confidence. Kinds from layaR itself: model_not_found, model_not_published, model_exists, invalid_argument, forked, bridge_json, bridge_invalid_option, bridge_engine_closed, bridge_panic. Model downloads and imports also use the engine's download, io and artifacts_not_found.
